classification_rule: Parse ASGI client and server hosts as IP addresses; reject if any parseable address is not loopback.
local_relay_residual: A local proxy, SSH forward, or relay that presents a genuine loopback peer is not distinguishable by socket-origin enforcement; local-caller trust/auth is deferred to L4-A4.
scope_limit: Network-origin hardening only; no authentication, token, TLS, OS identity, or secret mechanism added.
synthetic_rule: Non-IP ASGI identities do not themselves represent reachable sockets and may be accepted as in-process ASGI transport.
